messages:
Marta: quick thread: thinking about shard-aware orchestration for the onboarding bench. current flat queue leads to hot GPU spikes. propose per-shard queues + slow-start canaries.
Ibrahim: how many shard dims are we talking? seqlen x quant-profile x model-size?
Marta: start with two axes: quant-profile and seqlen-bucket. model-size used only for SLO tiers not sharding.
Keiko: that sounds good. does shard mean separate worker pools? extra infra cost?
Marta: not necessarily separate physical pools. logical concurrency slots per shard. workers pick up jobs matching their allowed shards. keeps GPU locality for heavy seqlen runs.
Ravi: what about golden coverage? we need to ensure each shard gets representative golden subset.
Marta: agreed. coordinator will sample golden per-shard using stratified sampling. default golden size 200 per model; per-shard min 20.
Zoe: edge: very small models where some shards empty. fall back to cross-shard sampling?
Marta: yes, if shard has <20 examples, coordinator merges with nearest shard by seqlen. fallback rule documented.
Ibrahim: runtime: when we quarantine, how does runtime know which shard failed? we tag the verdict?
Marta: verdict schema includes shard-level deltas. ex: golden_delta: {"q4":[0.03,0.04], "fp16":[0.01,0.02]}. runtime will consume aggregated verdict with a top-level state.
Keiko: prefer flattening for ledger compatibility. nested maps are painful for downstream queries.
Marta: fair. we'll flatten like golden_delta_q4=0.03; golden_delta_fp16=0.01 in ledger, full JSON kept in object store.
infra-bot: NOTE: storage retention defaults to 90d for bench artifacts. enterprise tenants can request longer retention.
Ravi: can we get a sketch API? I want to mock runtime subscription to shard events.
Marta: POST /onboard/submit -> {decision_id | verdict}. sample verdict payload (condensed):
```
decision_id: dec-98765
status: PENDING
shard_estimates: [q4:ETA=12m,p95=120ms, samples=40]
fastpass: [lint, tok_ok]
```
Keiko: how do we avoid duplicate runs on re-submits? use manifest hash + shard key?
Ibrahim: manifest-hash + artifact-version + shard-id seems ok. coordinator idempotent on that key.
Ravi: SLO tiers? product asked for <30m for fullbench. large seqlen-heavy models could break that.
Marta: propose seqlen-aware SLOs: weighted ETA = base_by_size * seqlen_factor. advertise ETA in decision. Ops sets hard timeout per-customer.
Zoe: cost visibility important. include estimated GPU-minutes per shard in preflight.
Marta: yes estimator will return gpu_minutes_per_shard and total. gateway can show ToS prompt for teams.
Keiko: tests: we should simulate straggler shards and noisy quant deltas. add a harness that replays shuffled golden sets across shards and injects noise.
Ibrahim: also add synthetic slow-worker test to validate slot backpressure and ETA corrections.
Ravi: rollback semantics? if shard X fails post-accept, do we quarantine whole model or just that shard?
Marta: quarantine semantics configurable per-policy. default: quarantine full model to be conservative. advanced policy: allow partial degradation (route requests avoiding shard-heavy ops) but that's complex. document as opt-in.
Zoe: sounds good. I'll draft policy examples: conservative, permissive, regulated-strict.
infra-bot: CI: onboarding-orchestrator tests queued (#823).
Marta: thanks. next steps: I'll PR an RFC with API shapes, flattened ledger keys, shard sampling rules, and SLO formula. meet Wed 10am to review.
